run_download_model_cli: run the CLI tool to download pre-trained fastText vectors for a given language like en or fr
run_download_model_overwrite: run the CLI tool with --overwrite flag to overwrite existing fastText model files
call_command_download: call command_download with a language id and if_exists policy to fetch pre-trained common-crawl vectors
review_command_download: review the command_download function that wraps fasttext.util.download_model for downloading language vectors
review_main: review the main function that parses CLI args for language and overwrite options before downloading
